title: Daily Signal Brief 011 — PTD count corrected to four states; AI Act consultation T-14
summary: Yesterday's PTD framing corrected within 24h via cross-source reconciliation with Littler's post-deadline brief: the directly-enforceable count is four (Italy + Slovakia + Lithuania full; Malta + Poland partial), not two — Compass's in-flight 6/9 post-mortem needs the update before publication. Commission has formally ruled out postponement and signaled at least ten member states face Article 258 infringement proceedings (Spain / Work-Life Balance precedent: €6.83M lump sum plus daily penalty). EU AI Act Annex III consultation closes 2026-06-23 (T-14, 9 EU business days) — re-elevated to L3 after three re-flags; Helm + Forge + Compass file/do-not-file decision target EOD 2026-06-12. L2 watch: Zellis acquired Hastee 6/5 — HCM M&A cadence sustained; reinforces Compass's one-platform buyer narrative. Three signals, not five; weekend/Monday quiet across competitor newsrooms.
